summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K on 14 October 2026 announcing the pricing of USD 1,000,000,000 5.908% Senior Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Notes due 2032. The notes were issued under NatWest's existing SEC shelf registration statement, with proceeds earmarked to fund its general banking business. The offering is scheduled to close on 16 October 2026, subject to customary conditions. NatWest Markets Securities Inc. can provide copies of the prospectus. This is a routine debt capital markets takedown, not a special situation. There is no equity event or deal term to arbitrage.
